whatSurvives: iteration-09-self-rejection.json, which holds the full written full-size frame verdict, the five rejection reasons with root causes, and the required-for-iteration-10 list
The iteration-09 pipeline decision and validations, preserved in pipeline.json historicalDecisions and historicalRevisions
cause: Iteration 09 was never archived into iterations/iteration-09/ before iteration 10 began. Its capture artifacts lived only in the live rev-011 directory, and PackOpeningGate04R011Builder.BuildAndRunCapture writes that directory in place. The iteration-10 capture runs overwrote the frames, contact sheets and capture report; the iteration-10 video re-encode overwrote the three mp4 files.
recoveryAttempted: git status and git ls-files: the entire rev-011 evidence directory is untracked, so no blob exists to restore
No pre-capture copy was taken of the frames, sheets or videos
preventionApplied: Iteration 10 evidence is archived into iterations/iteration-10/ in the same task that produced it, before any further capture can overwrite the live directory.
preventionStillMissing: The capture entry point still writes the live directory in place with no per-iteration output slot and no refusal when the live directory holds unarchived evidence. Until that is changed, archiving remains a manual step that a later agent can skip again.
impactOnDecisions: None of the iteration-09 conclusions depend on re-reading its pixels. The self-rejection was already recorded with per-criterion root causes, and iteration 10 was driven from that written record plus the parent's own full-size review. Iteration 09 remains self-rejected and must not be restored as a current requirement.
